newsitem.title: ITALY: Five die in two incidents on Mont Blanc.
newsitem.headline: Five die in two incidents on Mont Blanc.

text.p: Five climbers were killed and two injured in two accidents on Mont Blanc, Italian mountain rescue teams said on Sunday.
Four Spaniards fell to their deaths on Saturday as storms swept the mountain, which straddles the Italian-French border. Their bodies were recovered on Sunday.
A fifth member of the party, also a Spaniard, survived after he fell on to an ice ledge. He was rescued by helicopter and was recovering in hospital.
A German climber died after being plucked from the mountain in a serious condition on Saturday night. His Spanish companion was recovering in hospital in the Italian town of Aosta.
